findings.what: About 96 near-identical rows with no recommendation; too long to get through on a phone
Many tracks show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of any return, so 'how it has done' is missing
Two fee numbers per row (מהחיסכון / מההפקדות) with no plain explanation; pension 1.47% next to 0.16% is confusing
Index funds show fees split into קבועים/משתנים/נאמן and no returns, so I can't compare them with the gemel/hishtalmut tracks
findings.where: קרנות מחקות and קרנות סל tables, screens 10-12

findings.what: Fees only in percent, never in shekels
Product count 105 on the button vs '96 מסלולים' in the text
Lots of jargon tags (צוברת, מנוטרלת מט"ח, חשיפה לדולר, נאמן)
Table sorted by fee, not return, so the high-return tracks are scattered
